verdict.rationale: Elastic documents an ES|QL REST interface whose request-body parameters (filter, time_zone, locale) and output formats are described, and it offers a single ingest endpoint. Together these give programmatic query and ingest access. The evidence does not show a broader public API for driving the rest of the product (alerting rules, SLOs, cases, dashboards), and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the root-domain paths tried. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for managing rules, SLOs and cases; a published OpenAPI/reference spec; authentication docs; independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
